grammar.title: 语法知识 复数巩固
lines: 5 规则名词 (复习) 不规则 （单独记忆）
一般情况 + s ：books jobs
以s、x、sh、ch结尾 + es ：bu s es, bo x es, bru sh es, ben ch es
辅音 + o 结尾 + es： potatoes §
以f、fe 结尾变为 v + es： wi fe → wi v es, lea f → lea v es
以辅音 + y 结尾变为 i + es： bab y → bab i es （boy不是辅音+y结尾 → boys）
man → men
woman → women
foot → feet
tooth → teeth
child → children
sheep → sheep (单复同形)
fish → fish (单复同形)
单数名词 + is… 复数名词 + are…
This assistant is busy. Her feet are here.
My hair is black. The men are keyboard operator s .
Your book is interesting. The children are in the classroom.
